newsitem.title: USA: Medical Resources buys 2 imaging centers.
newsitem.headline: Medical Resources buys 2 imaging centers.

text.p: Medical Resources Inc said Tuesday it has agreed to acquire two New York diagnostic imaging centers.
The transaction is scheduled to close by November 25 and is expected to be accretive to earnings per share, Medical Resources said.
Medical Resources said it will own 38 centers after the acquisition, with 28 acquired this year.
"We are continuing to pursue other attractive diagnostic imaging acquisition opportunities," the company said.
Medical Resources shares closed Monday at 7-7/8.
Besides its imaging centers, Medical Resources also provides temporary healthcare staffing through its subsidiary, StarMed Staffing.
